why: Clearest storyteller of the four: crisp top end (95% rolloff 5.4 kHz), steady 3.3 words a second, the most life in his delivery.
chosen_from: 12 auditions (4 per host) of the best-matching male voices among 60 LibriTTS-R speakers, each reading the host's line with Chatterbox Turbo

measured_on_reference_line.line: In June of nineteen ninety seven, a crew came to cut down forty old trees. And that's one worth telling.

source.credit: Voice of LibriTTS-R speaker 7021. LibriTTS-R by Y. Koizumi et al. (2023), CC BY 4.0, derived from LibriTTS (H. Zen et al.) and LibriSpeech/LibriVox recordings.

voice_check: Every new line is compared with reference.wav (WeSpeaker voiceprint) and voiced again, steadier, if it scores under 0.70.
